en.headline: Observatory warns of flooding risk around Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 5pm announcement said more than 70 millimetres of rain fell in an hour in the northern New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special announcement on flooding in the northern New Territories at 5pm on Friday. It said heavy rain was affecting the area, especially Sheung Shui, and that more than 70 millimetres had been recorded in the past hour.

Residents likely to be affected were advised to take precautions against flood damage. The Observatory said heavy rain could bring flash floods, and people should stay away from watercourses and pay attention to nearby flood sirens.
The announcement was dispatched at 5pm. A thunderstorm warning issued at 3:55pm remained in force until 6:30pm.

zh.headline: 天文台發新界北部水浸特別報告 上水雨勢較大
zh.dek: 下午5時的特別報告指新界北過去一小時錄得超過70毫米雨量，上水一帶尤其明顯。
body: 天文台周五下午5時發出新界北部水浸特別報告，指大雨正影響新界北部，上水一帶尤其明顯，過去一小時錄得超過70毫米雨量。
天文台呼籲可能受影響的新界北居民採取預防措施，避免水浸造成損壞。天文台並指大雨可能帶來山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道，並留意附近的水浸警報。
該報告於下午5時發出。下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告當時仍有效至下午6時30分。
